content: The surveillance note for period 10 shows a trigger event has occurred, changing the principal payment mode to sequential. The pool balance fell to £49,151,533, with prepayments of £616,340, defaults of £153,395, and recoveries of £12,652. The 90+ day arrears ratio breached the limit at 1.32%, while the cumulative default ratio remained within limits at 0.45%. North West region accounts for 80.0% of the 90+ day arrears balance but only 11.4% of the pool balance.
